name: Mabaat
description: A digital property management platform in Saudi Arabia for luxury short- and medium-term rentals, delivered as a CMS, web app and mobile app.
highlights: Built the backend with Node.js and Fastify against a PostgreSQL database via Prisma.
Served as the core logic layer powering data processing and API requests, integrating third-party services including Hostaway and Payfort, and enforcing secure access control.
